name: 20-20-20 look-away
instruction: Look at something about 20 feet away for 20 seconds
why: gives your eyes a short screen break

name: Shoulder rolls
instruction: Gently roll shoulders 3 times forward and 3 times back
why: changes position and moves the shoulders

name: Hand open/close
instruction: Gently make a fist, then open the hand and spread the fingers; repeat 3 times

name: Slouch to tall
instruction: While seated, gently slouch, then sit tall; repeat 3 times
why: changes the sitting position and gently moves the lower back
restrictions: omit for back pain/limits or uncertainty

name: Stand and walk
instruction: Stand and walk near the desk for 60 seconds
why: breaks up a long period of sitting

name: Posture self-check
instruction: Check: head and neck balanced, shoulders relaxed, wrists in line, lower back supported, and feet supported
why: notices the current setup without a camera
